notes.title: Shakes on a Plane - Small balancing and fixes update has been released!
notes.notes:
🥤✈ Flight attendants!
We have just released another small update, which aims on balancing, when finishing levels with low scores. Additionally, we made some smaller fixes based on feedback from the community and streamers!

Balancing
The one and two-star limits were lowered slightly, to make it easier finishing levels with low scores

Interaction Fixes
We did some interaction fixes, such chopping which is no more so easily interrupted.
Special thanks to Stumpt enjoying our game and providing us with the respective feedback!

notes.title: Shakes on a Plane - Difficulty-Rebalance update has been released!
notes.notes:
🥤✈ Flight attendants!
Recently we have released a small update, which rebalanced the single player mode to make it more easier starting level 7 onwards.

As we have received feedback from our players, claiming the difficulty for single player mode in later levels being quite too challenging, we made some slight balacing changes with the latest update.

Thank you for your ongoing feedback and please keep it up! 🙌

notes.title: Short December progress update!
notes.notes:
Shakes on a plane is making good progress: we have just about finished all the raw level content, and are now adding "secondary mechanics" such as alien passengers and ragdolls to the game.  Currently with the alien passengers bugging out the cabin looks like a scene from The Thing (hmmh... there's an idea...)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33907858/6656a4fea11c53ac8e451a2b3b58febeff36a712.png

Scary, isn't it?

Of course the level content needs much more testing and balancing, and we are hoping to start closed alpha testing soon. The challenge is to design and balance the levels so that they will support varied amount of players. For this, we have a mechanism in place that adjust the difficulty per player count: this includes tweaking things like order frequency, turbulence alarm time etc. What we don't want to do is to alter the level itself per player count, and so far it seems we don't have to.

Other huge area we are making progress in are the cinematics. I'd say we have more to show on that front soon.
